title: 복습 B: 자음 — 가, 카, 까 구별하기
objective: You can tell plain, aspirated and tense consonants apart (자, 차, 짜) and read easy words with them.
summary: Review plain, aspirated and tense Korean consonants in easy everyday words.

task.title: Read, choose and write
task.line: Say each word aloud first, then answer using the letter groups on page 1.

letters.sound: Plain: soft, a little air; [g d b j] between vowels
Aspirated: a strong puff of air comes out
Tense: tight throat, almost no air

exercises: Is the first consonant plain (P), aspirated (A) or tense (T)? Write P, A or T: ① 포도 ② 꼬리 ③ 다리
Choose the correct spelling for the meaning: ① pants (바지 / 파지 / 빠지) ② It's big. (거요 / 커요 / 꺼요) ③ It's salty. (자요 / 차요 / 짜요)
Fill in the missing letter in each group (plain – aspirated – tense): ① ㄱ – ㅋ – ____ ② ㄷ – ____ – ㄸ ③ ____ – ㅊ – ㅉ
Write the aspirated consonant you find in each word: ① 고추 ② 우표 ③ 스키
answers: ① A ② T ③ P
① 바지 ② 커요 ③ 짜요
① ㄲ ② ㅌ ③ ㅈ
① ㅊ ② ㅍ ③ ㅋ
